note: Set B's claims are all correctly bound and value-complete: rated rotor speed 12.1 rpm, rated generator speed 1173.7 rpm, gearbox ratio 97:1, generator inertia 534.116 kg·m², drive-shaft spring/damping constants, brake torque 28,116.2 N·m and 0.6 s time constant, with the free-free-mode damping condition kept. Set A contains several clear errors: it reports rated rotor speed as 1173.7 rpm (that is the generator speed), truncates 867,637,000 to '867' and 6,215,000 to '6' and 28,116.2 to '2', and misbinds drive-shaft torsional constants and generator inertia to the high-speed shaft. Set A also mislabels the generator's 94.4% electrical efficiency as drivetrain efficiency. Set B is redundant but essentially error-free and covers the same key facts, so it is better.
